goal: Phase 1 only — the DESIGN. The person describes a style in words (90s retro anime cel look) for portraits of their own character from a photo. The agent must look for LoRAs proactively (lora_search) for the model each stage runs, pick ones trained for that model, put the trigger word in the prompt, and keep identity from the photo — mixing models across stages when the style LoRA exists only for a text-to-image model. It stops at the ask. Judged by reading the stage workflows.

reference.source: Comfy Cloud ships style LoRAs per model (zimage-90s_anime_aesthetic, flux1-lora-retro_anime_style, …); identity from a photo needs an edit model (FLUX.2 klein / Qwen-Image-Edit). A sound route: an edit stage restyles the person (with an edit-model style LoRA if one fits), or a styled text-to-image scene (Z-Image Turbo / FLUX.1 + style LoRA) then an identity edit.
steps: every stage that sets the look carries a style LoRA trained for that stage's model
identity from the photo is kept by an edit/reference stage, not by a text-to-image stage
must: lora_search was called for the stage's family/recipe
no LoRA trained for another model (the design check holds)
the trigger word, when the LoRA has one, is in that stage's prompt
the person's photo is a user input read by an edit/reference model

turns.text: I want portraits of my character in a 90s retro anime cel-shaded style — think old Sailor Moon / Cowboy Bebop screenshots. I'll give you a photo of the character. Make me the workflow.
